build_InputBlock: build an InputBlock module to featurize molecular graph input data into edge and global embeddings
create_atomic_embedding: create an atomic number embedding layer using nn.Embedding with uniform initialization for molecular elements
review_InputBlock_forward: review the InputBlock forward method that computes node embeddings from atomic numbers and node direction expansions
test_charge_spin_embedding: test the charge and spin embedding layers using ChgSpinEmbedding for molecular graph charge and spin features
refactor_edge_attr_linear: refactor the edge attribute linear layer to process edge distance and direction expansion features
